sites.downstream: Raw token stream returned to client via LangChainAdapter.toDataStreamResponse
sites.reason: Free-form streaming text completion from unconstrained user prompt. No closed-set selection, label, score, or routing decision. Output is piped directly as a token stream with no post-processing or branching. Jev produces typed decisions, not streaming prose.

options.benefit: No action needed. Site is pure generation with no decision component to extract or decompose.
options.risk: None. Leaving unchanged preserves current behavior.
